{{Quote|Good thing for me these guys are sloppy. Karrde would have had them shot. Now, to fin Kaerobani's collection.|Mara Jade, after easily sneaking into the Lumini pirates' base|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The '''Lumini pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang led by the pirate king [[Kaerobani]]. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], they attacked a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], stealing their cargo, which happened to include a rare [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]]. New Republic Jedi [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] tracked the pirates to their [[Kaerobani's base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]] where she battled the pirates, retrieved the [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi artifact]], and escaped in a stolen pirate [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==History==
===Early years===
[[File:OrbitingShipYards.png|thumb|right|230px|The Lumini pirates' orbital shipyard]]
{{Quote|Hey, what did we get this time?"'' <br /> ''"Usual stuff.|One Lumini pirate to another after a raid.|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the young [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] king [[Kaerobani]] led the Lumini pirates. Ambitious in spite of his youth, Kaerobani deployed his pirate gang on attacks for supplies and rare antiquities.<ref name="CSWE" /> While they operated from a large [[Kaerobani's base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]], the pirates stored [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] at their [[Orbiting Ship Yards]]. They also moved stolen supplies from their larger ships down to the planet by transferring them to the [[Shipyard/Legends|ship yard]]. At some point, the pirate gang stole an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Interdictor-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and used the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] in their raids.<ref name="MOTS" />

===Seizure of the Jedi holocron===
[[File:HolocronSeizureMara.png|thumb|left|200px|The Lumini pirates attack a New Republic corvette.]]
{{Quote|New Republic transport, prepare to be boarded! Your hyperdrive will not operate while under the influence of our gravity-well projectors. If you cooperate, this will be over quickly and painlessly.|A Lumini pirate aboard their Interdictor cruiser, to a New Republic corvette|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the pirates [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|launched]] another routine raid on a New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. Their [[Lumini pirates' Interdictor cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] pulled the corvette out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before sending a boarding party and fighters. While the pirates [[Death/Legends|killed]] a majority of the onboard crew before stealing the supplies, including a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Assigned to protect the artifact, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] snuck aboard the [[Lumini pirates' Nebulon-B frigate]] with the remaining cargo. After arriving at the pirates' orbital shipyard, she stowed away on a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] to the pirates' base. There, due largely to the raiders' sloppiness, Jade recovered the [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]] and escaped. However, the pirates retained the other stolen supplies.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Composition==
===Personnel===
[[File:Kaerobani_Head.png|thumb|right|160px|Kaerobani, leader of the Lumini pirates]]
{{Quote|It seems like they don't know I'm here...|Mara Jade, infiltrating Kaerobani's base|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The Lumini pirate raiders,<ref name="Story">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_story.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Story}}</ref> led by Kaerobani, were mainly castoffs from other smuggling operations. Though made up primarily of humans, [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] assassins and bodyguards also joined their ranks.<ref name="MOTS" />

===Pirate fleet===
{{Quote|It's always nice to meet new people and make new enemies.|Mara Jade, as she escaped in a stolen R-41 Starchaser|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The pirates' fleet was led by their Interdictor cruiser and their [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. The Lumini pirates also made use of various starfighter models commonly used by other pirate groups, such as [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]], [[R-41 Starchaser|R-41 Starchasers]], and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], but they notably also used [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing Assault Gunboats]]. They utilized Delta-class DX-9 transports and [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility tugs]] to move personnel and cargo from their capital ships and bases. [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] patrolled around the station during cargo deliveries.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The dread pirate Kaerobani (and that's me being clever with the word Caribbean) steals a [Jedi] holocron and Mara has to chase him to his hideout.|Developer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]]|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The Lumini pirates appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Designer [[Stephen Hwang]] laid out the game level where the pirates first appeared.<ref name="Blog" />
